2022_266_3_a_4315_proof_of_offer.verbose:
Agenda item 3.A. of the Troy School District Board of Education meeting of July 29, 2022, titled "4315 - Proof of Offer," bundles two attachments evidencing a buyer's capacity and formal offer to purchase real property at 4315 John R Road, Troy, Michigan 48085.

**Attachment 1 — loanDepot.com, LLC pre-approval letter**

The letter is a Pre-Approval Letter prepared for Scott Zitrick (#3001623561), issued 07/24/2022, with the property address stated as "to be determined." It advises that the borrower's actual rate, payment, and costs could be higher and that an official Loan Estimate should be obtained before choosing a loan. The lender states that, based on a review of income and assets provided, the credit report, and digital underwriting results, the borrower has been conditionally approved for a home loan on the following criteria:

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Purchase price | $265,000.00 |
| Loan amount | $251,750.00 |
| Loan product | Conv Fixed 30 Year |
| Occupancy | Primary |
| Credit | Documented |
| Income | Documented |
| Assets | Documented |
| Loan-To-Value | 95.000% |
| Issued Date | 07/24/2022 |
| Valid Until | 11/11/2022 |

The letter cautions that it is not an offer or commitment to lend and does not guarantee final loan approval; final approval is subject to a written application, executed sales contract, clear title, satisfactory appraisal, verification of the information provided, and full underwriting review by a loanDepot underwriter of the complete loan package. The pre-approval is expressly not contingent on the sale of real estate by the borrower. It is signed by Molly Greenawalt, Loan Consultant, NMLS #1506182, telephone (937) 661-5143, email mgreenawalt@loandepot.com, web page https://www.loandepot.com/loan-officers/mgreenawalt, address 524 South Main Street, Findlay, OH 45840; the office is identified as FINDLAY, OHIO with telephone numbers (419) 504-7973 and (833) 735-0854. Footer disclosures state that rates, terms, and availability of programs are subject to change without notice; loanDepot.com, LLC NMLS ID 174457; licensed by the MI Department of Insurance and Financial Services as a First and Second Mortgage Broker/Lender/Servicer Registrant FR0018571 / SR0018572; Equal housing opportunity; © loanDepot.com, LLC 2022.

**Attachment 2 — Purchase Agreement (6 pages)**

Paragraph 1, Property Description, identifies property located in Michigan, City/Township/Village of Troy, County of Oakland, Tax ID# 88-20-14-426-008, commonly known as 4315 JOHN R Road, Zip 48085. The legal description reads: T2N, R11E, SEC 14 PART OF SE 1/4 E 210 FT OF PARCEL DESC AS BEG AT PT DIST S 808.79 FT FROM E 1/4 COR, TH S 107.20 FT, TH N 81-05-00 W 764.22 FT, TH S 89-07-00 E 755.06 FT TO BEG 0.55 A EXC E 60' ROW. The sale includes all available sub-surface and mineral rights, fixtures, improvements and appurtenances, built-in appliances/equipment, shelving, cabinets, lighting fixtures, ceiling fans, attached carpeting, window treatments and hardware, attached mirrors, hard-wired telephone system, television antennae and brackets, satellite dishes (if owned) and rotor equipment, storm doors, storm windows, screens, awnings, garage door openers and transmitters, water softeners, security systems (if owned), mailboxes, fences, fireplace inserts, doors, gas logs, grates, gas attachments, attached humidifiers, landscaping, fuel in tanks, and central vacuum and attachments. Items written into the inclusion blank are: Dishwasher, Disposal, Free-Standing Gas Range, Free-Standing Refrigerator, Microwave, Stainless Steel Appliance(s). Excluded: Washer & Dryer.

Paragraph 2, Price: Two Hundred Forty Thousand Dollars ($240,000.00), in consideration for which Seller will provide a warranty deed subject to existing building and use restrictions and easements and rights of way of record.

Paragraph 3, Method of Payment: all money must be paid in U.S. funds by cashier's check, wired funds, or other funds acceptable to the closing agent. The transaction is structured as Option B, cash sale with a new mortgage, contingent on Purchaser securing a Conventional mortgage not contingent upon sale or closing of other assets, with a 5% down payment plus mortgage costs, prepaid items, adjustments, and flood insurance if required by lender. The completed blanks in this paragraph record periods of 5 and 30 calendar days for applying for the mortgage and for delivery of a mortgage commitment before Seller may declare the Agreement void. If the Buyer is denied the specified mortgage the agreement is null and void and the deposit is returned; if the appraised value is less than the purchase price, Purchaser may declare the agreement null and void and receive the deposit back.

Paragraph 4, Earnest Money Deposit: $2,400.00, payable by check, money order, cashier's check, or certified funds within 48 hours of seller acceptance, with a total earnest money deposit of $2,400.00 (the additional-sum line carries the entry 20.00). Funds are held in accordance with the laws of the State of Michigan and applied to the purchase price at closing, and are disbursed only per the terms of the agreement, a fully executed mutual release, or a civil action determination; if the offer is not accepted the deposit is returned to Purchaser.

Paragraph 5, Closing: on or before August 29th, 2022, at a mutually agreed location. Seller pays all state and county transfer taxes and other costs required to convey clear title.

Paragraph 6, Possession: delivered by 12:00 Noon 30 days after closing, with an occupancy fee of $0.00 per day payable by Seller for the period from closing through vacating; a Damage Deposit of $1,000.00 is to be retained by Broker in escrow from amounts due Seller at closing. A Seller failing to deliver possession as specified must pay twice the daily occupancy fee per day and may be liable for eviction costs, actual attorney fees, and damages.

Remaining standard provisions: home protection plan availability acknowledgment (paragraph 7); sewer and water charges with $300.00, or more if needed, retained in escrow for final water and sewer charges (paragraph 8); title evidence and survey, with Seller ordering title insurance at Seller's sole cost without standard exceptions in the amount of the purchase price (paragraph 9); title objections allowing Seller 30 calendar days to remedy title or obtain satisfactory title insurance and Purchaser 10 calendar days to complete the sale or waive (paragraph 10); taxes prorated as of closing, with Purchaser paying recording costs for the warranty deed (paragraph 11); assessments, capital equalization charges, voluntary liens, water/sewer charges, and lateral fees paid by Seller at consummation (paragraph 12); condominium/homeowners association assessments prorated (paragraph 13); maintenance of property, including de-winterizing at Seller's expense and leaving the property broom-clean (paragraph 14); utilities final billings (paragraph 15); risk of loss (paragraph 16); Seller's Disclosure Statement under Public Act 92 of 1993 (paragraph 17); lead-based paint disclosure for housing built prior to 1978, with a 10-calendar-day risk assessment window following acceptance (paragraph 18); default remedies for Purchaser and Seller (paragraph 19); additional documents attached (paragraph 20); flood insurance, with a Floodplain Certification to be obtained within 7 calendar days and notice of a Special Flood Hazard Area within 2 days of the Certification (paragraph 21); property inspection/due diligence contingency (paragraph 22); well and septic system inspection (paragraph 23); municipal inspections/certificate of occupancy at Seller's cost (paragraph 24); liability of Purchaser for inspection damage (paragraph 25); acceptance of the property in AS IS condition at closing (paragraph 26); a one-year post-closing limit for legal action (paragraph 27); no showings after offer acceptance (paragraph 28); FIRPTA applicability if the sale price exceeds $300,000.00 (paragraph 29); legal contract advisory (paragraph 30); disclaimer of broker(s) and release naming Brookstone Realtors LLC (paragraph 31); final walk-through within 48 hours prior to closing (paragraph 32); entire agreement (paragraph 33); time is of the essence (paragraph 34); successors and assigns (paragraph 35); facsimile/electronic authority accepting electronic signatures and initials accompanied by a certificate (paragraph 36); and paragraph 37, Attention Closing Agents, under which Brookstone Realtors (Broker) audits the closing file and $595.00 will be collected from Buyer at closing for a Broker Review & Compliance fee, a portion of which is shared with the Designated Agent at Broker's discretion. Paragraph 39 covers amendment, headings, grammar and syntax, governing law (State of Michigan), wire fraud precautions holding Brookstone Realtors LLC harmless, and severability.

Paragraph 38, Time Limit: the offer is valid until 11:59 p.m. on July 29th, 2022. Paragraph 40, Additional Terms and Conditions: "If appraisal comes in lower than the purchase price, the buyers agree to increase their existing down payment by $25,000, not to exceed purchase price."

Broker block: Listing Broker Brookstone, Realtors LLC and Selling Broker Brookstone, Realtors LLC; Listing Agent Richard McCarthy and Selling Agent Richard McCarthy; Agent ID# 440992 and Office ID# 406439; email rick.mccarthy10@gmail.com.

Signature page: Purchaser Scott Zitrick, dated July 28th, 2022, with the names Sara Kremhelmer and Scott Zitrick also appearing in the execution block, which provides for purchaser, seller, and witness signatures and a Purchaser's Acknowledgement of Acceptance of any Seller counteroffer. Electronic initial/audit stamps appear at successive page breaks: 608fd4d, 4057e39, 2d03c89, 94aa04d, ed94f15, 7462120, 1045b79, and 05f7901.
